name: Hut 8
exchange: Nasdaq (also listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange)

logo.source: hut8.com home page header logo (inline SVG, the sunburst mark in the fixed nav); no Wikipedia article for Hut 8 Corp. exists and the only Commons file is the old 2018 Hut 8 Mining mark. The site draws the mark in near-white (#F8F8F8) with a difference blend; fill changed to #111111 so it shows on light pages.

description: Hut 8 describes itself as an energy infrastructure platform with three layers: Power (powered land, substations and managed-services fees), Digital Infrastructure (data centers it builds and leases or hosts) and Compute (businesses that own the machines). Today almost all of its revenue is Bitcoin mining: 79 percent of FY2025 revenue and 90 percent of Q2 2026 revenue was Bitcoin rewards earned mainly by American Bitcoin, a majority-owned subsidiary (about 53.6 percent Hut 8) that Hut 8 hosts and manages. The company is converting its power sites into long-term AI data center leases: River Bend, Louisiana (245 MW IT, 15-year triple-net lease, tenant Fluidstack with a Google backstop) and Beacon Point, Texas (704 MW IT, two 15-year leases, about $19.6 billion base contract value with one high-investment-grade tenant). Reported profit swings with the Bitcoin price because Bitcoin is marked to market through the income statement (a $220 million loss in FY2025 and $434 million in the first half of 2026).

sub.name: Crypto exchanges, miners and bitcoin holders

employees.note: Full-time employees in the United States and Canada (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Compute: ASIC Compute (Bitcoin mining)
businessLines.how: Hut 8 and American Bitcoin point owned miners at mining pools and receive Bitcoin rewards in proportion to the computing power contributed; revenue moves with Bitcoin price, network difficulty and the halving (last April 2024, next expected 2028).
businessLines.description: Bitcoin mined by owned ASIC miners, mostly operated by American Bitcoin at Hut 8 sites (Alpha NY, Medicine Hat and Drumheller AB, Salt Creek and Vega TX, 50% of King Mountain TX).

revenue.note: Revenue recognized from Bitcoin mined, 1,803 BTC at about $103,647 average (FY2025 10-K Note 8 and MD&A). Latest quarter Q2 2026: $67.2 million (935 BTC at about $71,905; Q2 2026 10-Q Note 5 and MD&A). H1 2026: $129.4 million.

businessLines.revenueNote: Revenue recognized from Bitcoin mined, 1,803 BTC at about $103,647 average (FY2025 10-K Note 8 and MD&A). Latest quarter Q2 2026: $67.2 million (935 BTC at about $71,905; Q2 2026 10-Q Note 5 and MD&A). H1 2026: $129.4 million.

businessLines.name: Digital Infrastructure (hosting and colocation)
businessLines.how: Customers pay a fixed monthly colocation fee (or a profit share plus pass-through electricity) for space and power; for American Bitcoin the fee targets a 25% yield on cost of each facility but is eliminated on consolidation. The AI leases being built are 15-year triple-net, take-or-pay.
businessLines.description: ASIC infrastructure (hosting miners for third parties on fixed-fee or profit-sharing terms) and CPU infrastructure (Hut 8 Canada colocation); also the AI data centers under construction (River Bend, Beacon Point), not yet revenue-producing.

revenue.note: After eliminations, $9.6M (FY2025 10-K MD&A); gross segment revenue $86.2M before $76.6M of intercompany colocation with American Bitcoin eliminated. Q2 2026: $1.3M (gross $33.0M).

businessLines.revenueNote: After eliminations, $9.6M (FY2025 10-K MD&A); gross segment revenue $86.2M before $76.6M of intercompany colocation with American Bitcoin eliminated. Q2 2026: $1.3M (gross $33.0M).

businessLines.name: Compute: Traditional Cloud (Hut 8 Canada) and AI Cloud (Highrise AI)
businessLines.how: Traditional Cloud: customers commit to a baseline of compute, storage or power and pay extra for usage above it. AI Cloud: customers pay for GPU access on-demand or under committed-use contracts.
businessLines.description: Hut 8 Canada sells cloud, backup and colocation services from five Canadian data centers to more than 200 customers. Highrise AI rents GPUs (1,000 NVIDIA H100 and 96 H200 at 2025-12-31) from a third-party colocation site near Chicago.

revenue.note: Derived, not reported: Compute segment $202.4M less Bitcoin mined revenue $186.9M = about $15.5M for both lines combined. Q2 2026 derived: $72.5M - $67.2M = about $5.2M. Neither line's own revenue is disclosed in dollars (10-K says AI Cloud rose $7.4M and Traditional Cloud fell $1.2M in FY2025).

businessLines.name: Power (managed services and, until February 2026, power generation)
businessLines.how: Fixed fee based on power capacity under management (for American Bitcoin $1.25 per kW-month, eliminated on consolidation) plus pass-through costs; the sold gas plants earned capacity and electricity sales that varied with gas and power prices.
businessLines.description: Managed services to the King Mountain JV (280 MW) and to American Bitcoin; until the February 2, 2026 sale to TransAlta, four gas plants in Ontario (310 MW) through the Far North JV.

revenue.note: After eliminations (FY2025 10-K MD&A); gross segment revenue $41.9M. Q2 2026: $1.2M (gross $5.5M).

businessLines.revenueNote: After eliminations (FY2025 10-K MD&A); gross segment revenue $41.9M. Q2 2026: $1.2M (gross $5.5M).

businessLines.name: Other (equipment sales and repairs)
businessLines.how: One-time equipment sale when market price exceeds procurement cost, and per-job repair fees.
businessLines.description: Miner resales and a MicroBT-certified repair center at Medicine Hat.

revenue.note: Nil in FY2025, $7.6M in FY2024 (FY2025 10-K MD&A); not shown in Q2 2026.

businessLines.revenueNote: Nil in FY2025, $7.6M in FY2024 (FY2025 10-K MD&A); not shown in Q2 2026.

brands.name: American Bitcoin (Nasdaq: ABTC)
brands.share: Hut 8 owns about 53.6% (third parties hold 46.37% of the non-controlling interest at 2026-06-30); it generates nearly all ASIC Compute revenue, i.e. about 80% of FY2025 and 90% of Q2 2026 consolidated revenue. Owned fleet about 28.1 EH/s at about 16.0 J/TH after April 2026 (Q2 2026 10-Q).
